title: Patches, contrastive pairs, spoof scores, and kNN voice conversion
brief: Count and cut AST's spectrogram patches, write CLAP's symmetric contrastive loss, score a spoofing countermeasure by its equal error rate, and convert a voice by averaging its nearest neighbors in a target speaker's frames.
hints: ast_patch_grid is the output-size formula of a strided convolution: (size - patch) // stride + 1 along each axis.
patchify: build a (n_f, n_t, patch, patch) grid of row indices and one of column indices with broadcasting, index the spectrogram once, then reshape.
clap_loss: after F.normalize, the logits are a @ t.T / tau; F.cross_entropy(logits, arange(N)) is the audio-to-text half and F.cross_entropy(logits.T, arange(N)) the text-to-audio half.
equal_error_rate: np.searchsorted on the sorted scores counts how many fall below each threshold, which gives both error rates for every threshold at once.
cosine_knn: normalize both sides to unit length, and one matrix product gives every cosine similarity; np.argpartition finds the top k without sorting all of them.
knn_vc is one line once cosine_knn works: index the matching set with the (T, k) indices and average over the k axis.
